_about: Subsidies for a site in the canton of Geneva. Modes: percent (frac x gross), fixed (gross - amount), threshold (frac up to the threshold size, the discount capped at frac x cost of the threshold size above it).

battery.ocan_note: OCAN rule: max subsidised size (kWh) = yearly load (kWh) / 365 x ocan_factor. threshold_mode manual uses threshold_kwh as typed
